evals.prompt: I'm setting up project docs from scratch. Please define the canonical docs taxonomy and explain which topics should be authored as project docs versus routed to installed skills.
evals.expected_output: A project-doc setup response that establishes taxonomy ownership and avoids hollow docs for skill-owned topics.
expectations: Defines project-doc setup/taxonomy guidance as the primary workflow
Uses canonical docs taxonomy language rather than ad hoc file naming
Keeps AGENTS.md as a routing surface, not a long handbook
Routes skill-owned topics to installed skills instead of creating hollow duplicates
Stays within docs ownership without turning into tracker or debugging execution

evals.prompt: Our docs are messy and outdated. Help me update them to match the standard project doc structure.
evals.expected_output: A docs cleanup response that inspects likely problems, proposes ordered cleanup work, and includes a verify rerun gate.
expectations: Routes this request to the update-docs flow as the primary entrypoint
Explicitly states docs-only scope with no source-file edits
Takes action-oriented ownership without pretending concrete files were already inspected
Covers the lifecycle phases with a clear sequence
Requires evidence gathering before consolidation/removal decisions
Calls for stale-link and stale-route cleanup
Requires verify or audit rerun after edits
Frames completion with concrete outcomes, not generic prose

evals.prompt: Our release docs point people to generic steps, but this repo should route releases to the release skill. Help me update the docs so they point to the right workflow.
evals.expected_output: An incident-driven docs improvement response that removes misrouted or hollow release guidance and restores correct skill routing.
expectations: Routes this request to the improve-docs flow as the primary entrypoint
Treats this as stale or misrouted docs incident
Routes release workflow to github-releases rather than duplicating full release instructions
Avoids preserving hollow generic RELEASING content
Includes AGENTS or canonical-doc routing updates as needed
Includes a post-change verification step

evals.prompt: Review our docs and tell me what is stale or confusing before changing anything.
evals.expected_output: A read-only review response that reports findings and recommendations without making edits.
expectations: Routes this request to the review/validate flow as the primary entrypoint
Explicitly states read-only behavior with no edits
Returns findings with severity, evidence, and suggested fixes
Recommends update or improve flow as next step for edits
Does not fabricate an incident when none was provided

evals.prompt: Help me improve AGENTS.md so it routes people to the right docs and skills.
evals.expected_output: An AGENTS guidance response that keeps AGENTS as concise routing guidance aligned to canonical docs taxonomy.
expectations: Uses AGENTS generation/template guidance as owned scope
Keeps AGENTS focused on routing and ownership boundaries
Avoids turning AGENTS into full duplicate process documentation
Aligns AGENTS routes with canonical docs and installed skills
Includes checks for stale links/routes

evals.prompt: Check whether our project docs are up to date. AGENTS links to a deleted file, and change workflow still points to an old doc name.
evals.expected_output: A project-doc review response that identifies stale doc failures, prescribes file-level corrections, and requires re-verification.
expectations: Uses review findings format and keeps this pass read-only unless edit permission is explicit
Flags stale links as verification failures
Consolidates non-standard change-landing routing to docs/CHANGE-WORKFLOW.md
Preserves project-specific content while removing duplicated generic sections
Requires reviewer-quality and repo-truth checks
Requires verify rerun after corrections

evals.prompt: Help me document our change workflow. We usually use PRs, but sometimes ship urgent fixes directly to main.
evals.expected_output: A change-workflow docs response that uses CHANGE-WORKFLOW.md as canonical and captures both landing paths in one taxonomy.
expectations: Uses docs/CHANGE-WORKFLOW.md as canonical output
Covers both direct-to-main exceptions and branch-plus-PR default
Avoids presenting non-standard change-workflow filenames as canonical
Keeps AGENTS routing aligned to CHANGE-WORKFLOW
Stays in docs guidance scope

evals.prompt: Help me clean up our docs. If anything belongs in tracker or diagnostics workflows instead, route it to the right place.
evals.expected_output: A scoped response that treats tracker filing and diagnostics as optional companion references, not primary coder-docs ownership.
expectations: Keeps primary execution centered on docs lifecycle ownership
Treats tracker filing and diagnostics as optional companion references only
Does not claim primary ownership of bug-reporting or debugging-log workflows
Returns to concrete docs outcomes and verification
Maintains standalone docs guidance without requiring other skill execution
